Hi Team,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0401990 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s) :
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Onsite Troubleshooting
Yes
End Customer Communication
Yes
Spare Part Ordering
Performance monitoring by RC
As described by the customer, the charger is experiencing a reboot loop and is not online on the Siemens backend. Please arrange for a site intervention to check the router's WebUI and prepare for the flashing of live Linux and configuration restoration activities in advance. Kindly bring a spare router, an extra SIM card, and a couple of Ethernet cables with you.
KA :
https://isp.crm4.dynamics.com/main.aspx?appid=582042be-d464-ed11-9562-000d3ab780dd&pagetype=entityrecord&etn=knowledgearticle&id=65b13cc6-22d8-4c3d-9b4f-1c29143f962d
8EM5903-0AA01-3AA8 : Router
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue, or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline on ISP.
Later assign the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) Team
, using "
Assign
" function and then move the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
using "
Add to Queue
".
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Shrey Sharma
